# rust-boilerplate

> A Rust starter with a hello-world app and a local MCP harness for building, reloading, inspecting, and profiling your code.

The application starts in `src/main.rs` and only prints `hello world` before exiting.
Reusable tooling lives in `src/runtime/`; instrumented test workloads live in `tests/fixtures/`.
Read the workflow for repository work, then load only the guides relevant to the task.
Links are relative to this file. Guide paths and commands are relative to the repository root.

## Development

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.txt): Requirements, layout, build commands, project naming, and first run.
- [Repository workflow](docs/workflow.txt): Task scope, editing, verification, and evidence requirements.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.txt): Daemon, MCP launcher and worker, optional channels, and build profiles.
- [Testing](docs/testing.txt): Unit tests, isolated lifecycle checks, and profiling integration tests.

## Tools

- [Agent setup](docs/agent-setup.txt): Connect an MCP host and understand worker rebuilds.
- [MCP tools](docs/tools.txt): Tool reference, batch requests, startup guidance, and failure recovery.

## Optional

- [Profiling](docs/profiling.txt): Instrumentation, memory inspection, Valgrind, and before/after comparisons.
- [Events and activity](docs/events.txt): Activity viewer, compiler events, notifications, and troubleshooting.
